info.title: ForeScout
info.description: ForeScout Platform (CounterACT / eyeSight) discovers, classifies, and assesses the compliance posture of every device connecting to the network. The Web API exposes read-only visibility into discovered hosts, the host field definitions those hosts are classified against, and the policies/rules driving that classification.
info.x-itential-curated: ForeScout does not publish a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger reference for the Web API, so there is no larger upstream spec to trim from -- this spec was authored directly against the Web API's read-only visibility surface: host lookup by ID, IP, and MAC, host listing, host field definitions, and policy/rule listing (6 operations). The separate Data Exchange (DEX) module (list and host-field updates) uses HTTP Basic auth and XML request/response bodies -- a different, incompatible auth method from the Web API's JWT header, so it's out of scope for this spec per the repo's one-securityScheme-per-spec rule. See the repo README for details.

servers.description: ForeScout Enterprise Manager or standalone Appliance.

get.description: Retrieves details of a single host identified by its ForeScout object ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ForeScout ID number for the host.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of host field names to include in the response. If omitted, all fields are returned. Field names can be discovered via GET /api/hostfields.

401.description: Unauthorized -- missing or expired Authorization JWT.

404.description: No host found matching the specified ID.

parameters.name: fields

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of host field names to include in the response. If omitted, all fields are returned. Field names can be discovered via GET /api/hostfields.

401.description: Unauthorized -- missing or expired Authorization JWT.

get.description: Retrieves a list of active endpoints known to ForeScout, optionally filtered by the policies/rules that matched them.

parameters.name: matchRuleId
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of policy and/or rule IDs. Only hosts matched by all of the specified policies/rules are returned. Policy and rule IDs can be discovered via GET /api/policies.

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of host field names to filter/include. Field names can be discovered via GET /api/hostfields.

401.description: Unauthorized -- missing or expired Authorization JWT.

get.description: Retrieves the index of host fields (properties) that ForeScout can report on for a host, including each field's label, internal name, description, and data type.

401.description: Unauthorized -- missing or expired Authorization JWT.

get.description: Retrieves the policies configured in ForeScout, including each policy's rules.

401.description: Unauthorized -- missing or expired Authorization JWT.

HostFieldValue.description: A host field's value as returned under Host.fields. Single-value fields are a single {value} object; list-type fields are an array of {value} objects.

value.description: One element of the list-type field's value.

id.description: ForeScout ID number for the host.

fields.description: Map of host field internal name to its value(s). Only the fields requested (or all fields, if none were requested) are included.

hostId.description: ForeScout ID number for the host.

label.description: Display label of the host field.

name.description: Internal name of the host field, as used in the 'fields' query parameter and in Host.fields keys.

type.description: Data type of the host field's value, e.g. string, integer, ip, boolean, date, list.

rules.description: List of rules that make up the policy.

webApiAuth.name: Authorization
webApiAuth.description: JWT retrieved dynamically by POSTing username/password (as application/x-www-form-urlencoded body fields) to the Web API's login endpoint. Unlike a typical dynamic-retrieval target, the login response body is a raw plain-text JWT rather than a JSON envelope -- Itential Platform's dynamic retrieval treats an empty/root JSONPointer ('') as 'use the whole raw response body', so responsePointer is intentionally blank here rather than pointing at a field. The JWT is used verbatim on the Authorization header, with no 'Bearer ' prefix, and is valid for 5 minutes before ForeScout expires it -- Itential Platform re-retrieves it automatically before each request.

x-itential-parameters.name: username
x-itential-parameters.description: ForeScout Web API username, configured in the ForeScout console under Tools > Options > Web API > User Settings.

x-itential-parameters.name: password
x-itential-parameters.description: ForeScout Web API password, configured alongside the username.
